llm_response.reason: The website offers products of a well-known brand (Agatha Ruiz De La Prada) at an unfamiliar and recently registered domain. There are insufficient or missing company/contact details, no clear privacy or policy links, and bulk product listings. These patterns match typical fake e-commerce scams seeking to exploit brand reputation and lure customers with free shipping and secure payment claims, without evidence of being an authorized reseller or official store. Additionally, lack of legitimate reviews and presence of typical scam indicators (unclear business info, suspicious domain) confirm the risk.
